text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pokke! Pokke! Pokke! Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!?
Whoa, what's going on?

One day, Jungle Pocket and I found ourselves
surrounded by Umamusume on the Tracen Academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, you're amazing!
Beating that many rivals back-to-back!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming with you!
Please, teach me how you run.

They were enthusiastic devotees.
Yes, Jungle Pocket was...
Junior Class, Classic Class, Senior Class. In every single GⅠ, she never lost once to the two from her generation.

Yes, both to Agnes Tachyon
and to Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pokke! Pokke! Pokke! Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haha, who knew there'd be this many people whose hearts were completely captured by my running?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This fervor... If the fiercest competitors of Tracen Academy hold me in such high esteem—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, partner.
I just came up with an idea.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm letting this momentum slip away.
I'll gather it all into one, and then—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I will turn it into a massive swell.
One powerful enough to shake the very history of Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, you bastards!
I, Jungle Pocket, am—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I decided to form a new team within Tracen Academy.
Its name is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: 『L/Roars T』！

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Roars... Tea... That's the same name as the team Pocket-san used to lead...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Could the 'T' by any chance stand for
the 'T' in Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "L/Roars T is a team made up of folks who share my soul."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone who felt something from my run, follow me.
We're gonna rule the Umamusume world. And what's more—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It ain't just for now.
For years and decades to come,
let's make this the reign of 『L/Roars T』!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!!
Pokke, Pokke, Pokke, Pokke...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho. Well, well, well...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, esteemed experts.
The reason I gathered you all here is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Subject Jungle Pocket.
I was hoping to ask you about your own significance
and how your sense of value has changed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
From our respective specialized academic viewpoints.
First—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey, the Feng Shui Umamusume.
Let us hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “Indeed. The fortune surrounding Pokke-san is distinctly shifting.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From "Mishap" to "Calm," and further on to "Longevity."
In other words, we might turn decline into prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. What is the astronomical perspective,
Neo Universe-kun?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Astronomy... Neo Universe doesn't
understand it. But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"An 'unknown' galaxy is approaching.
A galaxy containing neither a 'Great King' nor a 'Singularity'..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see, so basically, what this means for
Pokke-san and her crew's future is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It says "Great Fortune"!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, it certainly appears so.
Fortune-telling Umamusume, Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The existence of a single individual can alter the very history of evolution.
The biology of Umamusume is truly fascinating.
Now then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What kind of impact it might have on the ecosystem later on.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Listen up, you bastards! Don't you dare lose. Not to Universe, not to Rob Roy. And not to Kitasan or Diamond either.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We are the strongest team.
Carve it into the turf—the mark of 'T'.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

The remarkable record left by Jungle Pocket
did not merely elevate her fame—
"It would go on to drastically reshape the Twinkle Series landscape for years to come."
